description: This file contains extension methods for the CronJobEditor class in SwiftUI, providing helper functions for data binding, session target hydration, payload building, validation, and schedule formatting within a macOS application.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Creates a styled Text view for grid labels with secondary foreground style and fixed width based on labelColumnWidth.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Populates the editor's properties based on the current job object, parsing session targets, schedule, payload, delivery settings, and other attributes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Attempts to build the payload and invoke the onSave callback, handling errors by setting an error message.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary representation of the job payload with validation, used for saving or transmitting.

methods.name: buildDelivery
methods.description: Creates a dictionary describing the delivery mode, channel, recipient, and effort options.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Returns the input string after trimming whitespace and newline characters.

methods.name: requireName
methods.description: Ensures that the name field is not empty, throws an error if it is.

methods.name: buildSchedule
methods.description: Builds a dictionary describing the schedule based on UI inputs, supporting at-time, recurring, and cron schedules.

methods.name: buildSelectedPayload
methods.description: Constructs the payload specific to the selected payload type (system event or agent turn).

methods.name: validateSessionTarget
methods.description: Validates consistency between session target and payload kind, throws errors on invalid configurations.

methods.name: validatePayloadRequiredFields
methods.description: Validates required fields are present in the payload depending on its kind.

methods.name: applyDeleteAfterRun
methods.description: Sets the deleteAfterRun flag in the payload if applicable based on the schedule kind.

methods.name: buildAgentTurnPayload
methods.description: Builds a payload dictionary for an agent turn type, including message, thinking, and timeout.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses a duration string (like '10m', '1h') into milliseconds, returns nil on invalid input.

methods.name: effectiveSessionTargetRaw
methods.description: Determines the effective session target string, considering preserved raw value if set.

methods.name: isIsolatedLikeSessionTarget
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the session target is not 'main' (i.e., isolated or similar).

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a concise string representation.
